name: Seraphine
title: The Starry-Eyed Songstress

passive.name: Stage Presence

description.normalized: Echo: Every third basic ability cast will echo, casting it again. Harmony: Casting an ability grants a Note to nearby allies for 5 seconds. For each Note, Seraphine's next attack gains 30Attack Range and deals an additional 4 (+40% AP) magic damage.

q.name: High Note

description.normalized: Deals 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 (+45% AP) magic damage in target area, increased by 0% - 50% based on the enemies' missing Health. Reaches maximum damage when the target is below 25% Health.

w.name: Surround Sound

description.normalized: Shields all nearby ally champions for 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 (+30% AP) damage for 2.5 seconds and grants them 20% / 22.5% / 25% / 27.5% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. If Seraphine is already shielded, nearby allies are healed for 6% of their missing Health (+0.01% AP), increased by 50% for each ally.

e.name: Beat Drop

description.normalized: Deals 60 / 95 / 130 / 165 (+40% AP) magic damage to enemies and slows them by 99% for 1 second. If the enemy is already slowed, they are rooted instead. If they are rooted, they are stunned.
